sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-N of JU D Unit 2018-2019 occupies book PDF pp.142-145 (printed book pp.141-144): paper header on p.142; questions re-grouped by the book into 'Short Syllabus' (pp.142-145), 'Extra Syllabus' (p.144: Q01, Q03, Q04, Q09, Q11) and 'Old Syllabus' (p.145: Q57, Q58) boxes; printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান') on p.145 followed by printed worked solutions for selected questions (19, 23, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 41, 47, 50, 51, 63, 76) — every worked-solution key letter agrees with the answer table; for Q63 the solution adds a note citing a ৬০০:১ ratio from a newer edition, which is not among the printed options (flagged on that question, table key kept). The answer table keys all 80 questions with single letters — no dashes and no dual keys. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page with zoomed re-reads of all question blocks, the answer table and the solutions; chemical/mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, plain digits for subscripts); Bengali and Latin numerals preserved exactly as printed.
